text:
sam: Quick follow-up from INC-4822 postmortem. We keep hitting large blast radius when slow priming and staged ramp coincide. Proposing a small, low-risk set of changes we can ship this week.

maria: agree. prefer incremental: (A) micro-canary option (0.1% initial cohort) + automatic step-up, (B) lightweight circuit-breaker based on cohort_kv_miss and error-rate, (C) flag ownership export so support knows who to call.

jon: i'll prototype micro-canary in the rollout service. idea: `initial_percent: 0.1`, then exponential steps (0.1 -> 0.5 -> 2 -> 10) with health checks. target 48h.

sam: for circuit-breaker, propose two conditions: cohort_error_rate_delta >= 1.5% OR cohort_p95_delta >= 150ms sustained 3m => pause and notify. If kv_miss > 12% in cohort => immediate pause. jon: can you wire these signals?

jon: yes. will emit a `rollout.health` metric with tags {rollout_id, flag, cohort}. quick YAML sketch for policy: 
```yaml
micro_canary:
  initial_percent: 0.1
  steps: [0.1, 0.5, 2, 10]
  step_interval: 5m
circuit_breaker:
  error_delta_pct: 1.5
  p95_delta_ms: 150
  kv_miss_threshold: 0.12
```
I'll include opt-out metadata for Dedicated tenants.

maria: export: please add CSV export (`tools/flag-inventory --fields flag,owner,blast_radius,rollout_policy > flags.csv`) so support has an ownership column. also add lint to block PRs without owner.

support: yes please. we'll use the CSV to auto-generate a short support card: 3 bullets explaining rollback reasons and contact.

eng-sre-bot: Created task RG-1201 "micro-canary + circuit-breaker" assigned to jon + sam. Shadow job `rollout-shadow` scheduled.

jon: plan for rollout: (1) add metric emission and circuit logic behind feature flag (2) deploy feature flag off to prod (3) enable and run 7-day shadow against 20% of traffic, compare false positives. demo in 72h.

sam: i'll add CI validation that disallows default rollouts with initial_percent > 1 without explicit approval and block schedules overlapping known priming windows (infra/jobs/priming_windows.yaml). ETA: Tue EOD.

maria: SQL snippet for weekly report to find risky rollouts:
```sql
SELECT rollout_id, flag, AVG(kv_miss) as avg_kv_miss, MAX(error_delta) as peak_err_delta
FROM rollout_health
WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY rollout_id, flag
HAVING AVG(kv_miss) > 0.08 OR MAX(error_delta) > 1.0
ORDER BY avg_kv_miss DESC;
```
We'll land that into the weekly incident hygiene dashboard.

jon: after circuit-breaker is live, we'll run a staged canary for one week and then enable auto-stepups for selected flags. on Dedicated tenants auto-stepup is disabled until customer opt-in.

maria: owners and due dates: (micro-canary prototype: jon, +2d), (circuit-breaker metrics + rule: jon+sam, +3d), (CI blackout lint + owner-lint: sam, Tue EOD), (flag CSV export + lint: maria, +4d), (shadow run: eng-sre-bot scheduled, +7d). I'll add these to the postmortem tracker.

sam: adding a short runbook snippet for on-call: 3 steps — (1) pause rollout, (2) revert to last-good variant if errors persist for 6m, (3) notify owners + follow postmortem playbook.

support: we'll prep a templated customer note for rollbacks and a FAQ entry.

jon: opening a draft PR and will link here. cc @eng-sre-bot for shadow orchestration.

eng-sre-bot: Ticket RG-1201 created, shadow job `rollout-shadow` queued.

maria: thanks all. i'll check tracker on Friday and escalate if anything slips. ping here for PR links.
